page.overview:
Who is Chief Armstrong?

Chief Armstrong, known as Takasu () in the Japanese version, is a character in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's Duel Transer. This is a video game depiction of Mr. Armstrong, a character from the Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's anime. He is encountered in the Yggdrasil Entrance.
